name: TimeMan Actions
shellCommand:
txt=$FREEWAY_TEXT
encoded=$(printf '%s' "$txt" | jq -sRr @uri)
open "timeman://handle?speech=$encoded"
if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then
	osascript -e '
	set theButtons to {"Not Now", "Find on Website", "View in App Store"}
	try
		activate
		set theAlert to display dialog "TimeMan.app is required to process speech" with title "Freeway" buttons theButtons default button 3 cancel button 1
		set clicked to button returned of theAlert
		if clicked is item 3 of theButtons then
			open location "itms-apps://apps.apple.com/app/timeman/id1484426198?mt=12"
		else if clicked is item 2 of theButtons then
			open location "https://timemanapp.com"
		end if
	end try
'
fi
